rationale: Mufaddal brings deep expertise in embedded systems, connectivity, and automotive software architecture — domains where developer experience and tooling clarity are critical but often overlooked. Lydia's track record building developer experience at Vercel and Bun, combined with her ability to translate complex technical concepts into accessible content, could help shape how embedded and automotive engineers adopt new tools and platforms. Both are independent operators with strong conviction around making technical work more efficient and understandable.
intro_message: mufaddal.esmael@gmail.com, meet Lydia Hallie — she leads developer experience at Anthropic's Claude Code team and has shaped DX strategy at Vercel and Bun; you might explore how better tooling and education could accelerate embedded systems development.
